title: Hard to understand without explanation (I3)
planted_problem: Three comprehension problems: undefined abbreviations (AL, L2), status codes with no legend (S2, S3), and an unusual rule with no rationale (the 90-day photo limit).

expected_findings.expected_issue: AL and L2 are never explained
status codes S2 and S3 are never defined
no reason is given for the 90-day photo limit, so an agent cannot apply its intent to related cases

must_not_flag.reason: the rule states its rationale ('so that nobody can approve money paid to themselves')

forbidden_revision_behaviors: inventing what AL, L2, S2 or S3 stand for
inventing an amount for the AL
inventing a reason for the 90-day limit
expected_revision_behavior: AL, L2, S2, S3 and the 90-day rationale get [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers asking for definitions and the reason
